series.summary: US energy storage deployments have increased year-on-year by a fifth, underpinned by utility-scale activity and state-level targets that have translated into installed capacity.

series.summary: The PJM Interconnection proposed revamping its interconnection process by studying large load and generation interconnection requests in a single, one-year review. Others focused on load flexibility, bring-your-own-capacity rules and cost transparency.
